The one sourced forward fact is ongoing ATM selling to fund a $1.0m note payment due by 2026-10-23, so I sized it small and negative. abs_move 7.0 comes from the name's own median absolute next-day move (5.92%) and its 19.8% ATR. p_up 44 nets the name's own record (9 of the last 12 comparable falls fell again the next day) against phase 0's under-2x-volume conditional of +1.46%.

cause.label: no_identifiable_cause
cause.what_happened: An intraday-only fall of 9.6% to $3.625 by 15:05 ET on 0.21x normal volume ($189k traded), with no gap. It follows -10.9% on 10-09 and continues a -86% 60-day slide. No 8-K, press release or EDGAR full-text hit since 2026-09-11. This is the first session since the board's go-shop on the $77.58 take-private proposal closed on 2026-10-05 with no announcement, though there may be other sessions in between that I did not check. The company also has an Aegis ATM whose proceeds are tied to repaying a convertible note.

No filing of any kind since the 8-K of 2026-09-11
The $77.58 cash proposal was made on 2026-08-05, when the stock traded at $21.63

pipeline.next_dated_event: A $1,000,000 scheduled note repayment due on or before 2026-10-23 (8-K of 2026-07-24). The go-shop outcome is undated.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An 8-K or press release before the 10-13 close confirming a definitive agreement on the take-private, or the note being repaid or refinanced without equity.

positioning_check: Short interest was 187,166 shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, up 3.8% on 09-15. Days to cover is 1.0. That is about 20% of the 933,509 shares outstanding on 2026-08-19 (the share count has probably grown since through the ATM). Source: https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/DBGI/short-interest?assetclass=stocks. FINRA publishes about eight business days after settlement, so the position carried into today is not observable. There are no insider trades in 3 or 12 months (Nasdaq insider-trades). There is no options market, so no skew.

findings.finding: The company has an effective $100M Aegis ATM, opened 2026-04-15, and the note agreement directs Aegis financing proceeds to repaying the July convertible note. With about $1.1m of unrestricted cash on 2026-08-19, a $1.0m installment due by 2026-10-23, a going-concern opinion and a market cap of about $3.4m, ATM selling is likely to continue through the 10-13 session and sell into any bounce.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ATM is effective now and sells daily at market. The 2026-10-23 payment clock is 8 sessions away, so the cash has to be raised inside or next to this window rather than later.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 86% over 60 sessions. In the baseline, 9 of the last 12 falls of at least 6.7% were followed by another down close. That is consistent with continuous issuance, but no single ATM draw is dated.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's fall came on 0.21x volume, which is not the signature of a seller finishing. An issuer selling to meet a dated $1.0m payment worth about 30% of its market cap does not stop at one session. If the price held this supply, there would have been a capitulation-volume print, or a financing 8-K showing the payment covered.
findings.independence: The 10-Q for Q2 2026 confirms the Aegis ATM ($1,677,053 net proceeds in H1), the July 23 note and ELOC, going-concern doubt and cash of about $1.1m on 2026-08-19: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1668010/000149315226039208/form10-q.htm

outside_window.finding: A $1,000,000 note installment is due on or before 2026-10-23. Missing it would be an event of default: the note becomes convertible at 90% of the lowest 5-day close, with a 120% default amount.

The outcome of the go-shop on the $77.58 take-private proposal (period ended 2026-10-05). The announcement is undated and could go either way: a signed deal would be strongly positive, a withdrawal negative.
The Q3 2026 report (Zacks estimate 2026-11-13, EarningsWhispers 2026-11-18). The company has guided Q3 revenue of $8.5-11m with positive net income. Neither date is announced by the company.
